transcript: These two services can't finish starting. Spring starts service A, whose constructor needs service B. But service B needs service a first. The arguments must exist before construction. Neither constructor can finish. Startup fails with a bean currently in creation exception. This is a constructor cycle. Refactor the collaboration. An orchestration service calls A and B. They no longer depend on each other. Our tests confirm failure before and successful startup after. Other circular references behave differently. Redesign the dependency graph. Thanks for watching.
